**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The MSA contains a robust Vendor-side indemnity at Section 10(a) (p0047–p0051): Kubient defends, indemnifies and holds harmless AP and its personnel against all third-party Claims arising out of or in connection with the Services, the Auction Platform, the Creative, Kubient's breach of its reps/warranties, and the acts or omissions of Kubient and its subcontractors. Since Kubient's warranties include IP ownership of the Service/Auction Platform and compliance with applicable Law, the indemnity captures third-party IP infringement, unlawful conduct and Kubient misconduct — at or above the preferred position, with no super-cap or exclusions to negotiate. Section 11 provides standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics, and Section 9(a) carves indemnification out of the damages exclusion.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged: AP's reciprocal indemnity in Section 10(b) is slightly broader than the preferred "Customer content plus breach of law" formulation (it also reaches misuse of the Services/Platform and AP's acts or omissions). That is customary mirrored drafting and does not impair the Vendor indemnity, so it is not redlined under this rule.
